confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Theme initialization occurred both in page files and shared renderers, causing Streamlit session-state mutation errors.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Theme initialization is now page-owned and shared renderers no longer initialize it a second time.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: 52/52 expansion pages passed isolated runtime checks; zero captured exceptions and zero new runtime error logs.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Several expansion pages bypassed the common theme bootstrap.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: All pages 112-163 now initialize the common theme exactly at page level.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Nested JSON lists/dictionaries could fail duplicate profiling; Reactome pathway files could lose the first record as a header.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Nested values are normalized only for duplicate checks and headerless Reactome files receive explicit pathway columns.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: Nested JSON and Reactome regression tests passed.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Generic CSV/Excel files received an unexpected instrument_format column.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Generic schemas remain unchanged; only recognized vendor/RDML workflows attach instrument-specific columns.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: Generic schema preservation regression test passed.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Quick diagnostics could fall through to deep scientific scans and reports recomputed the same diagnostics three times.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Quick mode always returns after bounded checks and report generation reuses one diagnostics snapshot.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: Measured governance path improved from approximately 29 seconds to approximately 4.7 seconds in the development environment.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: The packaged analytics warehouse contained fewer events than the dashboard/benchmark contract expected.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Idempotent backfill restores complete warehouse coverage.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Fourteen Step 104 reference datasets lacked complete readiness, schema and QC rows.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Automatic idempotent backfill profiles real bundled files and creates schema/QC/readiness records.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: 66/66 datasets have files, columns, QC, provenance and readiness records.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Featured content was overcrowded, new category labels were not normalized, and a structural typo could rank the wrong module first.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Featured entries reduced to 25, aliases map into the shared taxonomy and curated structural intent ranking was repaired.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: Navigation, search credibility and UI quality suites passed.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Eight pages read upload bytes without consistent size, extension and empty-file preflight.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Shared upload profiling and usability validation now gate all eight paths.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: 8/8 high-risk upload pages passed runtime checks; 165/165 pages passed static upload-safety audit.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Minimum BioIntel versions were compared lexicographically, which misorders versions such as 10.10 and 10.5.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: Numeric semantic version tuples are compared against the current package version.

confirmed_defects_fixed.defect: Release versions were inconsistent across desktop, mobile, iOS, Android, store, Docker, Helm, Terraform and policies; offline wheel verification was not enforced early.
confirmed_defects_fixed.fix: All application release surfaces are synchronized to 10.5.0 and the Windows installer runs wheelhouse preflight before offline installation.
confirmed_defects_fixed.verification: Release, Windows hardening and production-upgrade suites passed.

limitations: The complete 165-page AppTest sweep was not claimed because running all heavy pages in one process accumulated test-runner resources; all pages received static validation and new/high-risk pages received isolated runtime validation.
Specialist external algorithms, current reference databases, wet-lab confirmation and independent clinical/regulatory validation remain external requirements.
